payload.summary: Accept both documentation-fix amendments (error message text and doc comment clarification) as they address real inaccuracies. Reject both blocking amendments because the habitat/geometry probe suite, summary runner, and per-habitat debug output all exist in crates/tank_harness/tests/e2e_habitat_geometry_probes.rs — the amendments appear to be describing a different (alkalinity-focused) change set.

votes.rationale: Verified: SMALL_MEDIA_CM2=500 and LARGE_MEDIA_CM2=4000 (line 292-293), making the ratio 8×, not 2×. The error message at line 497 reads '2× media should expand filter habitat area by >1.5×' which is objectively wrong. A developer debugging a failure would be misled about the test configuration. Simple, safe string fix.

Verified: configure_redox_baseline sets aeration.enabled=false (line 1101), the planted arm does not override this, but the inert arm explicitly sets aeration.enabled=true and intensity=0.6 (lines 1167-1168). The doc comment at line 1027 claims the comparison is 'about substrate geometry and root-zone effects' without acknowledging the aeration asymmetry. Adding a note that the inert arm also has aeration enabled (and explaining why this strengthens the test) makes the documentation technically accurate without changing any behavior.

The amendment's claim that no habitat/geometry probes exist is factually incorrect. crates/tank_harness/tests/e2e_habitat_geometry_probes.rs (1640 lines) contains all five required probes: biofilter_scaling (line 289), light_depth, habitat_fouling, substrate_redox (line ~1017), and equipment_scaling, plus the all_habitat_geometry_probes_summary runner (line 1561). The amendment appears to describe a different alkalinity-focused diff, not the actual habitat/geometry implementation.

The claim that per-habitat diagnostics are missing is incorrect. e2e_habitat_geometry_probes.rs contains format_habitat_debug (line 44) and dump_habitat_debug (line 133), which emit per-habitat biomass, colonizable area, and habitat modifiers. These are called at 11 locations throughout the probe suite (e.g., lines 464-465, 730-731, 886-888, 1226-1227, 1461-1462). The engine.rs and budget_helpers.rs files being aggregate-only is irrelevant — the bead's per-habitat diagnostic requirement is fulfilled by the harness-level debug functions.
